slowest_experiments.experiment: SMT-conflict inference-cost stress and exact-tool guard on mandated SOTA GGUFs
V566 direct-source, model-cache, and dependency contract
Independent DRIFT corpus provenance, chronology, and replay audit v2

summary: Seven experiments completed in 6.6 minutes, and three were compute-bound. The 5.53-minute SMT-conflict inference-cost stress and exact-tool guard was the clear timing tail; the task-conditioned GPU-idle field was false.
bottlenecks_identified: The 5.53-minute SMT-conflict inference-cost stress and exact-tool guard occupied most of the 6.6-minute milestone window and formed the primary critical path.
The timing data has no phase-level split for model loading, cache access, inference, SMT work, or exact-tool validation, so it cannot establish why the longest compute-bound task took 5.53 minutes.

The top-five timing list contains two compute-bound rows although the locked count is three, and it has no task-window GPU or runner receipt; the third compute task and accelerator dispatch cannot be audited from the supplied data.
improvements_suggested: Add monotonic phase timers and a warm model-cache and dependency preflight to the GGUF compute harness so setup, inference, SMT work, and exact-tool validation have separate timings.
Record GPU utilization inside each compute-bound task window and bind every sample to the task title and compute-bound marker.
Emit model-count, concurrency, and runner-selection receipts; use DualGPURunner only for parallel multi-model work.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Profile the 5.53-minute stress-and-guard path by phase, then reuse validated model-cache and dependency preflight receipts.
Capture task-scoped GPU duty-cycle telemetry for every compute-bound task.
Make model count and concurrency explicit at dispatch, with conditional DualGPURunner selection for parallel multi-model work.
meta_reflection: Disk-mtime reconstruction ranks the visible tasks but cannot prove the cause of the 5.53-minute tail or whether the 0% GPU snapshot overlapped compute. The locked false GPU-idle classification remains unchanged, and no data available this milestone establishes parallel multi-model loading or a missed DualGPURunner engagement.
